comment: Words that must not appear in text the app paints onto textures (plan §0e): the championship, real sponsors and suppliers, other circuits, the teams, and (I phase) the makers whose names sit on the Sketchfab ops props — crowd barriers, cranes, tools, PA, canopies — and Tecpro, the barrier maker (its texture left at I4-c). Matched word-bounded and case-insensitive by scripts/textures-lint.mjs; existing hits are recorded verbatim in scripts/trademark-allow.json.
